Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent provided factually incorrect information regarding the death location of William Walton. While the agent correctly identified the composer and the date of death (March 8, 1983), it incorrectly stated that he died in "Naples, Italy." The correct location is Ischia, Italy (specifically the town of Forio on the island of Ischia). This error likely stemmed from the agent misinterpreting the visible text on the Wikipedia page (which mentions "Naples" in the context of his burial or a specific work, but not his place of death) or hallucinating the location despite the search results in Step 1 showing a Wikipedia link that would have contained the correct infobox data if properly parsed. The agent failed to verify this specific fact against the authoritative sources it was instructed to consult (Britannica or the full Wikipedia infobox) before reporting the final answer.
